description: The 'dss_projects_cached' dataset provides a comprehensive overview of various projects within a data science platform, capturing essential metadata and status information. Each project is uniquely identified by a 'projectKey', which serves as a primary identifier for tracking and management purposes. The dataset includes details about the project owner through the 'ownerLogin' column, which helps in identifying the person responsible for the project. The 'tutorialProject' column indicates whether a project is a tutorial, which is useful for educational or demonstration purposes. The 'name' and 'shortDesc' columns provide a descriptive title and a brief overview of the project, respectively, aiding in quick identification and understanding of the project's purpose. The 'projectStatus' column reflects the current state of the project, such as 'Sandbox', indicating its development phase. Additionally, the dataset tracks the 'contributors' involved in each project and the 'lastModifiedOn' timestamp, which is crucial for version control and collaboration. The 'tags' column allows for categorization and easy retrieval of projects based on specific labels. This dataset is valuable for project management, tracking progress, and facilitating collaboration among team members in a data science environment.
shortDesc: Dataset of cached DSS projects with metadata and status.

columns.name: projectKey
columns.comment: Unique identifier for each project, tracking key.

columns.name: ownerLogin
columns.comment: Username of project owner, indicates responsibility.

columns.name: tutorialProject
columns.comment: Indicates if project is a tutorial, boolean value.

columns.name: name
columns.comment: Title of the project, descriptive name.

columns.name: projectStatus
columns.comment: Current status of the project, e.g., 'Sandbox'.

columns.name: contributors
columns.comment: List of project contributors, JSON array format.

columns.name: lastModifiedOn
columns.comment: Timestamp of last modification, tracks updates.

columns.name: shortDesc
columns.comment: Brief description of the project, free text.

columns.name: tags
columns.comment: Categorical labels for the project, JSON array format.
